page.overview:
Who is Windmill?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Windmill was available in the 1988 series of A Real American Hero toys, packaged exclusively with the Skystorm helicopter. ---- Appearance: black helmet with orange crest; orange shirt with green open shirt and tubing; orange pants with black boots

Accessories: large, black revolver with trigger some distance from grip. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/88/windmill.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/88/windmill.shtml Filecard]
